name: mirage
text: Checked Novig's raw ledger. (1) Paid back 273 dollars is gross: it includes each stake coming back, and your money recycles all day (bids fill, settle within hours, get re-staked). That is why 8,043 dollars was staked in total on a wallet of about 150, and why you never held 270 at once. Profit is paid back minus staked, +66. (2) Cash did grow: the ledger nets about +75 on Nov 14, +21 on Nov 15 and +52 so far today (UTC days, fees included), roughly +148 over three days. The engine status showed the wallet near 0.01 dollars on Nov 15 and it is 148.06 now. Not yet explained: the Tracker game-day +66 for Nov 15 differs from the ledger cash +21 that day, and the all-time card still shows -70.27 from logged bets. I will reconcile those.
